summary: Converted VS Code Task Operations extension into AIWorkHub active-repository dashboard. Every window binds one MCP session to the selected workspace repository; multiple windows/repositories remain isolated.

rename_display_to_aiworkhub.details: displayName=AIWorkHub, Activity Bar title=AIWorkHub, view name=Dashboard, command titles prefixed AIWorkHub:. Extension ID geoai-task-operations preserved. Legacy command IDs (geoaiTaskOperations.*) registered alongside new aiWorkingHub.* commands.

single_folder_auto_bind.details: getActiveRepositoryRoot detects folders.length===1 and auto-binds, persisting to workspaceState.

multi_root_explicit_selection.details: Multi-root requires explicit repository selection via QuickPick. Selection is persisted in workspaceState under aiWorkingHub.repositoryUri. Never silently uses folders[0].

one_mcp_child_per_window_and_repo.details: Exactly one childProcess.spawn call site. getMcpClient compares repositoryRoot and tears down stale client on repo mismatch before creating new one.

aiworkhub_repo_env_var.details: Both AIWORKINGHUB_REPO and legacy AIWORKHUB_REPO env vars passed to the MCP child process.

same_name_repo_isolation.details: repositoryLabel disambiguates same-name folders by appending parent directory segment. Repository binding uses full URI string, not folder name.

repo_switch_teardown.details: selectRepositoryCommand stops old client, clears mcpClient, persists new URI, starts new client, pushes repositoryInfo to all views.

webview_readonly_strict_csp.details: All existing protections preserved: nonce CSP, no iframe, no eval, no unsafe-inline, frame-src none, tool allowlist, sanitizeWebviewPayload, hidden-view polling pause, no write/launch gate env, no innerHTML.

repo_label_without_host_path.details: repositoryLabel uses folder.name only. The Webview receives a repositoryInfo message with just the label string. Host-absolute paths stay in the extension host.

coordinator_note: Worker completed all acceptance criteria. Codex owns install/reload, integration validation, and final commit.
